visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair and bangs is seen in an indoor setting, looking directly into the camera. She holds a small, light blue transparent bottle and a matching blue cardboard box with 'OLENS O-Fresh' branding. Her facial expression is friendly and engaged, with consistent eye contact. (2) She brings the product bottle and box closer to the lens, demonstrating the packaging. The background consists of a brightly lit indoor room with cream-colored furniture. (3) The shot changes to a close-up of her right hand, where a clear contact lens is placed on her index finger. With her other hand, she carefully tilts the blue bottle and squeezes a single drop of liquid onto the lens. (4) She is seen lifting her upper eyelid with her hand and looking into a mirror (off-camera) as she inserts the treated contact lens into her eye. (5) After the application, she talks back to the camera, blinking naturally and smiling, indicating satisfaction with the product's effect.
